summary: Frontend-only verification of the SHAKE-COLLISION bug fix in Home.jsx (global useShake guard bails when surpriseReveal or showThemeWelcome is active, and enabled=false while surpriseReveal). All three targeted flows PASSED using synthetic DeviceMotionEvent bursts (accelerationIncludingGravity via constructor, threshold=14 m/s^2 crossed with ±25 alternating x @ ~60-100ms intervals).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx L580: useShake enabled prop is `!spinning && !loading && !surpriseReveal` but doesn't include `!showThemeWelcome` or `!showGuided`. The early-return inside the callback catches these cases, but for symmetry with the guard consider adding them to the enabled expression too (avoids attaching listener at all during first-run modals).

useShake.js: after enabling changes, `last` baseline is reset via new effect run — but cooldown/lastFire state also resets, so a shake immediately after the guard lifts could fire faster than intended. Not observed as a bug here (COOLDOWN=3000ms applies within a single lifecycle), but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded via add_init_script: ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1, ff_rare_force=8ball, ff_deal_taps=9, ff_rare_at=10, ff_muted=1. Cleanup at end removes ff_rare_force/ff_deal_taps/ff_rare_at.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Synthetic DeviceMotionEvent works in headless Chromium: `new DeviceMotionEvent('devicemotion', {accelerationIncludingGravity:{x,y,z}})` produces a usable event that useShake.js accepts. To cross the THRESHOLD=14 delta with two jolts inside JOLT_WINDOW=900ms: dispatch a baseline (x=0), then alternating ±25 events at 60-100ms intervals. COOLDOWN=3000ms after a fire — wait >3.2s between test bursts. Magic8Ball completion via pointer rattle: press-drag alternating ±80..90px across the ball for ~20 reversals; may need to retry after taunt fails (MAX_FAILS=2 before guaranteed answer). After ritual, ff_rare_force stays in localStorage (not cleared by app — expected), but ff_deal_taps=0 confirms the rare-fate counter reset.

test_evidence.test_1_shake_collision_fix: PASS — With magic-8ball-overlay mounted (data-state=idle), dispatched a devicemotion burst polling every 50ms for 2s. saw_shuffle_popup=False (guard held), ball_left_idle=True (Magic8Ball's own useShake still fired → stage progressed shaking/message/answer). The pre-fix bug would have started a whole new deal (shuffle-popup) — it did not.
test_evidence.test_2_global_shake_still_works: PASS — After completing the 8ball ritual (overlay unmounted, waited 3.2s for cooldown), dispatched an identical burst. shuffle-popup mounted → new deal triggered. Confirms guard only suppresses during rituals.
test_evidence.test_3_no_shake_sensor_regression: PASS — Plain click on [data-testid=spin-roulette-button] succeeded without JS errors after the ritual/shake flows; no .error nodes rendered.
